entry_policy: Existing per-stock long/short signals and execution risk controls; no historical-profitability admission gate
activation_inventory: Clone each source stock ledger into candidate and control; preserve balances, existing positions, funding and fills
confirmation_policy: Two consecutive closed signal bars closing after activation and entry; fast/mid EMA opposite the position and close opposite slow EMA
exit_execution: Latch full exit; retry observed depth with existing quantity limits and costs; existing cooldown applies
user_authorization: User authorized strategy experiments that continue normal paper trading without historical research admission blocking
